messages:
Aisha (CS): morning async — Orion Health renewal check. quick run-through what I did / blockers / today

Aisha (CS): what I did: verified the embedding latency spike on prod (p95 ~1.2s -> 3.6s), collected sample requests, flagged customer timeline for renewal team. attached logs: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/orion/PROD/2026-03-12

Aisha (CS): blockers: embed latency causes poor search relevance and customers are seeing slow UI. not sure if it's kv-cache churn or a bad quantized build after last model update. also need eng review for a tentative rollback window before renewal call.

Devon R.: saw the same in staging yesterday. suspect the recent 2-bit quantization branch on the 7B model increased memory pressure and caused more CPU scheduling on host side. small repro: run 100 concurrent embedding requests with varying seq len.

Devon R.: quick logs snippet I used:
```
for i in $(seq 1 100); do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-7b","input":"sample text"}' &
  done
```

Quinn L.: re: eng review — I can do a fast PR + canary revert for the model artifact if we agree. can you paste the failing request IDs? I want to run the reproducible load against the dedicated pool for Orion (if they have a reserved bucket).

Aisha (CS): added two request IDs to the ticket and pinned them here: rq_20260312_11a, rq_20260312_11b. Orion is on dedicated-reserved-03 in us-west-2. renewal call Fri 09:30 PT.

Maya S.: FYI infra-bot shows a small memory OOM trend on gw-host-12 around that time. i'll warm up the dedicated pool and add a short scaling rule to pre-warm during the renewal window. can someone confirm we want automatic rollback to previous model if p95 > 2s after warmup? :thinking_face:

Devon R.: yes to rollback. I'll open a hotfix PR to pin the artifact and add the fallback policy in rollout config. Tagging @Quinn for review.

Quinn L.: on it — will review in ~30m. if I don't ack here ping me in #eng-runtime.

infra-bot: deploy-bot report — Canary deployment to dedicated-reserved-03 started at 3632101400, health checks failing on 1/3 instances, auto-rollback policy not triggered (flagged).

Aisha (CS): thanks infra-bot. Devon/Quinn — if rollback is needed please coordinate with me so I can loop Renewal SMs and schedule a short window for switching.

Maya S.: I'll patch the autoscaler to pre-warm and set scale min to 2 for the window. sending PR now. :rocket:

Devon R.: PR for pin + fallback opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/5421 — cc @Quinn L. contains the rollback config and a test.

Quinn L.: reviewed and left one minor comment about the healthcheck timeout. should be quick. after merge I'll kick canary and monitor p50/p95 for 10m before greenlight.

Aisha (CS): perfect. Today: monitor canary, prep renewal notes, and sync with renewals team on Fri timeline. If anyone sees extra regressions or more request IDs, drop them here. :phone:
